title: Man Gardening Under Porch Deck, 1950s Sepia Snapshot, Light Leak
description: A candid vintage mid-century snapshot depicting an older gentleman wearing glasses and a t-shirt with a cigarette resting in his mouth as he tends to plants near the base of a porch deck. The photo has deckled edges and exhibits a severe light leak/overexposure flare obscuring the right side of the composition.
